title: Sunny Rooms (stock happy/comic interior, SNES register)
_note: Stock HAPPY-B playful interior (Georgina's cottage, the Lifting House on Pearlmoor Quay). 126 BPM 4/4, C major, 32 bars: A (8) -> A' (8) -> B (8, F major then a D7-G7 cheeky turnaround) -> A'' (8, last bar walks up F# to G to lead back). Ocarina-ish triangle lead with staccato skips and chromatic neighbour notes (the wink), staccato sampled bass (bassoon-ish oom-pah eighths), pizzicato offbeat dyads, xylophone (bell) fills in the lead's rests, tambourine on hat/ohat. Cheeky but warm, never manic. No motif.
